title: Incident automation for customer-visible 5xx waves with rollback gating and tenant-safe fallback
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: During the last multi-tenant incident we observed correlated 5xx spikes originating from a model-variant rollout + KV cache thrash pattern. Manual rollback and tenant isolation worked, but coordination was slow and caused repeated customer escalations. This ticket implements an automated incident gating system that pauses rollouts, applies tenant-safe fallbacks, and orchestrates a controlled rollback path with clear customer-facing status updates. Goals: 1) Detect customer-visible 5xx waves within 90s and open an automated mitigation runbook. 2) Gate rollouts and automated deployments when a detection rule triggers. 3) Provide tenant-scoped safe fallback that routes affected tenants to a compatible older model variant or reduced concurrency path without requiring manual intervention. 4) Log a deterministic decision trail and produce an incident summary for postmortem/SEV. Out of scope: full rewrite of batching runtime; this ticket focuses on orchestration, detection, and the rollback gate integration with existing rollout machinery.
acceptance_criteria: Anomaly detector alerts on 5xx rate > 2x baseline per tenant for 90s and triggers the mitigation pipeline
Automated gate halts active model rollouts for any deployment flagged by the detector within 3 minutes
Fallback routing moves affected tenants to a preconfigured compatible model variant with a documented precision/latency tradeoff
Customers in the affected tenant list receive a templated status update via the escalation channel within 10 minutes of detection
Runbook creates an auditable event that includes detector signals, chosen fallback, rollback reason, and operator override actions
steps: Implement anomaly rule in observability (Grafana/Prometheus) and wire to incident-manager webhook
Extend rollout controller with a 'rollback_gate' boolean and API to pause/resume active rollouts
Add tenant-fallback mapping table to config (model_variant -> fallback_variant) and safe-traffic-cutover logic
Implement an automated play execution: detect -> gate rollouts -> assign fallback -> notify escalation channel -> produce incident artifact
Smoke test in dedicated staging with synthetic tenant bursts, validate that fallback keeps requests < SLO degradation threshold
Integrate audit events into Console incident timeline and add a one-click operator rollback override
